title: Machine learning tools for the characterization of bioactive metabolites derived from different parts of Ochrosia elliptica Labill. for the management of Alzheimer's disease
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10671-10690
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00021A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohamed A. Salem, Essam Abdel-Sattar, Asmaa A. Mandour, Riham A. El-Shiekh
Ochroisa elliptica revealed 41 compounds using UPLC-MS/MS and assessed their binding affinities to cholinesterase enzymes through molecular docking. A quercetin derivative exhibited the strongest binding. Additionally, dynamic simulations confirmed stable interactions.
